advisory.finding: `fitted = outbound_mapper.map_fields_to_remote({"description": local_desc}, ...)` is now computed unconditionally on every reconcile pass, before the directionality guard, whereas previously it ran only when the field was NOT suppressed by inbound. Under the rich (cutover) codec this call fans out to `render_markdown_to_wiki`, which spawns a pandoc subprocess per renderable unit — so every ticket's description now pays a pandoc round-trip on every pass even when the body is unchanged and will be suppressed.
merged_from: The outbound rich-text fit (`fitted = outbound_mapper.map_fields_to_remote({"description": local_desc}, ...)`) is now computed unconditionally for every ticket, hoisted ABOVE the `_suppressed_by_inbound` directionality guard. Previously it ran only inside the `if not _suppressed_by_inbound(...)` branch — skipped whenever the local body was unchanged since baseline (the steady-state / converged case). In rich mode this call renders Markdown to wiki markup via `render_markdown_to_wiki`, which spawns the pandoc binary as a subprocess per renderable unit, so the change adds one (or more) pandoc subprocess invocation per bound ticket on EVERY reconcile pass, including the common case where nothing changed and the guard would suppress emission.
scenarios: Cutover client (rich_text_cutover=dc/both) reconciling a large backlog where most descriptions are unchanged/suppressed — each pass now shells out to pandoc for every description that would otherwise short-circuit on the inbound-suppression guard.
